title.purpose: Content card titles, sheet primary heading.

body.purpose: Long-form description, sheet body paragraphs. Cap at 65–75ch.

body-tight.purpose: Step copy, related-card titles, dense list items.

label.purpose: Format/category/eyebrow chips and section heads. Always uppercase, 800 weight, 0.08–0.12em letter-spacing.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Reserved for future use. Default surfaces ship without shadow.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Reserved for dropdowns, menus, elevated tiles.

shadows.name: shadow-glow-blue
shadows.purpose: Signal-blue presence. Active video play marker; rare emphasis.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet-up
shadows.purpose: Upward cast on the learn-more bottom sheet. The only upward shadow in the system.

shadows.name: shadow-poster
shadows.purpose: Video poster tile shadow inside the learn-more sheet.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA focus ring. Wide solid Signal Blue.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and overlay fades.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: chip activation, icon button toggle.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Default transition: button hover, focus ring.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Surface entrance: overlay fade, sheet slide.

breakpoints.name: mobile-max
breakpoints.purpose: The learn-more sheet drops the side margins and goes full-bleed below this width.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Signal Blue pill CTA, lifts on hover, Signal Blue focus halo. The system's default primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary-blue, #0092ff); color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42); transform: translateY(0); transition: transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease, filter 140ms ease; cursor: pointer; will-change: transform; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 0; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42), 0 0 0 6px var(--primary-blue, #0092ff); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); transition-duration: 60ms; filter: brightness(0.98); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition-duration: 1ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Outbound Button
components.description: Anchor Navy pill button used to leave the product or descend into a source. Deeper than the primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-outbound { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #22224c; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-outbound:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -8px rgba(34, 34, 76, 0.45); } .ds-btn-outbound:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0092ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Outline Action
components.description: Secondary pill action (Save, Share). Becomes filled Signal Blue when toggled active.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill-outline { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #d9dfea; background: transparent; color: #22224c; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-pill-outline:hover { background: #f6f6ff; } .ds-btn-pill-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0092ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-pill-outline[data-active='true'] { background: #0092ff; border-color: #0092ff; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Format / Category Chip
components.description: Uppercase 10–11px metadata chip. Typographic, not container-shaped. Color carries the role.
components.html: Video Trades
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip--format { color: #0092ff; } .ds-chip--category { color: #485163; }

components.name: Content Card / Tile
components.description: Studio Off-White tile with soft Slate Frame Light border. Flat at rest. Used for related cards, step tiles, content list items.
components.html: Article · 4 min What a junior product designer actually does
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; min-height: 112px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #e5e9f1; border-radius: 12px; background: #f6f6ff; color: #22224c; text-align: left; text-decoration: none; transition: background 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #d9dfea; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0092ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card__meta { color: #485163; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card__title { padding-right: 20px; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.32; } .ds-card__arrow { position: absolute; right: 13px; bottom: 13px; color: #65738b; }

components.name: Takeaway Callout
components.description: Pale Sky tinted card with Signal Blue border at low alpha. Used for key insights inside long-form content.
components.html:
Key Takeaway

Internships beat resumes in the first three years — specifically Canadian roles you can name.
components.css: .ds-callout-takeaway { padding: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 146, 255, 0.22); border-radius: 14px; background: #e6f4ff; } .ds-callout-takeaway__eyebrow { margin-bottom: 8px; color: #0092ff; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-callout-takeaway__body { margin: 0; color: #22224c; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Numbered Step Tile
components.description: Step list item with a 30×30 Signal Blue badge. The most assertive single application of Signal Blue in the system.
components.html:
1

Pick three career lanes that catch your eye — don't filter for realism yet.
components.css: .ds-step { display: flex; gap: 13px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #e5e9f1; border-radius: 12px; background: #f6f6ff; } .ds-step__badge { width: 30px; height: 30px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0092ff; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-step__body { margin: 0; color: #22224c; font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview:
Career LaunchPAD is a switchboard of possibilities, lit up. The stage is Studio Off-White (#f6f6ff) — bright, calm, low-commitment — anchored by Anchor Navy (#22224c) as the steady ink and inverse surface. Signal Blue (#0092ff) is the spark: a single accent that lights up the active path, marking the 'this connects to that' moment for a student moving through content. The palette is small, the chrome is quiet, and the content is loud.

The system serves a student who is browsing ambiently inside myBlueprint, not arriving with intent. It must earn attention without demanding it: typography-forward, generously spaced, flat at rest, and confident on press. Motion is responsive — buttons lift on hover, the learn-more sheet rises from the bottom of the viewport — but never choreographed for its own sake. Reduced-motion preferences are honored at the keyframe level, not as an afterthought.

This system explicitly rejects the LMS / school-software aesthetic, the Government-of-Canada portal stuffiness, the SaaS-dashboard cliché, and the corporate career site framing. Career LaunchPAD is content-first, not a dashboard; exploration, not job-hunting; current, not commemorative.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white stage, navy ink, single signal-blue accent — disciplined three-color palette.
Open Sans across every register, leaning on weight (300–900) and case (uppercase 10/11px labels) for hierarchy instead of multiple type families.
Flat at rest, lifted on intent — shadow is a state signal, not decoration.
Pill-shaped CTAs with bold focus halos; uppercase 10–11px label chips for category and format metadata.
Bottom-anchored learn-more sheet as the one true overlay surface.

rules.name: The One Spark Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue covers ≤10% of any rendered screen. If a comp shows blue on more than one CTA per fold, the second one is wrong. Active states win over decorative ones.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Never #000 and never #fff for text or large surfaces. Studio Off-White carries page background; Pure White is reserved for elevated card surfaces. Anchor Navy carries body ink; Slate Ink and below carry secondary copy.

rules.name: The Tinted-Border Rule
rules.body: Every border is on the navy-hue ramp (Slate Frame Light through Slate Echo). Never a chromaless gray. Never a colored side-stripe.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata chips (format, category, eyebrow, section head) are always uppercase, 10 or 11px, 800 weight, 0.08–0.12em letter-spacing. Sentence-case at this size is forbidden — it reads as small body copy and breaks the rhythm.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is achieved by weight (and occasionally case) within Open Sans. A second display family is forbidden. Prefer 800/900 weight contrast with 400/500 over reaching for a serif.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: New components ship with no shadow. If a designer wants to elevate a card, the question is: is this currently the focus, or is it just a card? If it's just a card, it stays flat.

rules.name: The Up-Cast Exception
rules.body: The learn-more sheet is the only surface that casts a shadow upward. Every other elevation goes downward. Don't add new up-cast surfaces.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue (#0092ff) at ≤10% of any rendered screen. Reserve it for the primary action, the active focus halo, the play marker, and the format chip color.
Do use Open Sans for everything. Reach for weight (300–900) and case (UPPERCASE 10–11px labels at 0.08–0.12em letter-spacing) before reaching for a second family.
Do pill-shape every button (border-radius: 9999px). Rectangles are reserved for cards and tiles.
Do ship surfaces flat by default. Add shadow only when something is actively elevated (sheet, hovered CTA, focus halo).
Do tint every neutral toward the navy hue ramp. Borders are Slate Frame Light / Mid / Echo, never chromaless gray.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion at the keyframe level. The learn-more sheet entrance already does this — every new animation must too.
Do put the focus ring on every interactive element. The 6px Signal Blue halo on the primary CTA is the reference. Never outline: none without a replacement.
Do lead with content (videos, articles, real Canadians). The UI scaffolds the content; it is not the hero.
donts: Don't use #000 or #fff for body text or large surfaces. Studio Off-White and Anchor Navy are the closest you go.
Don't ship a purple-to-blue SaaS gradient. The system has one accent; the only 'gradient' is the focus halo on the primary CTA, and it isn't really a gradient.
Don't stack identical icon-card grids ('hero-metric template' or 'feature-grid SaaS'). Career LaunchPAD is content-first; varied tiles beat a uniform grid.
Don't introduce a serif display family. The Weight-Over-Family Rule is a hard line.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent. Side-stripes are an absolute ban.
Don't apply Inter, system-default sans, or any non-Open-Sans face to ship. Inter is a flag for AI slop in this register.
Don't reach for glassmorphism outside the learn-more overlay. The 8px backdrop-blur on the sheet wash is the only blurred surface in the system.
Don't stage the Government-of-Canada / Service Canada aesthetic — dense forms, gray-on-gray tables, 'official' framing.
Don't lean on red maple leaves, mountain photography, or hockey imagery to signal 'Canadian.' Trust through specificity earns it instead.
Don't use bounce / elastic easing. Easing is ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) or ease-standard (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)). Never spring overshoot.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (top, left, width, height). Use transform for entrances, opacity for fades.
Don't force students through pop-ups, mandatory sign-ups, or completion-guilt UI. The system earns attention; it doesn't extract it.
